layout.body: The mechanics at the Summit Auto Parts Supply company have announced a great advance in the technology of auto-related instruments such as electric hand drills and spanner wrenches. In the past，these have generally been fashioned out of the heavy steel parts and angled at a certain degree, but this new technology enables mechanics to have a flexible-angle tool by which they can extend their arms to reach areas that need repair and control their movements much more. These auto-related tools will weigh less than ever before because they are made from titanium. Most mechanics show compliments on this improvement. On the other hand, some strongly criticize the additional cost of purchasing instruments made with the new technology.

questions.stem: What does this report mainly discuss?

options.A: A good capacity of the auto-related supplies
options.B: A new technology that improves the durability of the instruments
options.C: A high-tech invention by the mechanics
options.D: A development in the production of auto-related tools

questions.analysis: What does this report mainly discuss? 原文依据：第一句提到 a great advance in the technology of auto-related instruments，后文介绍新工具的材质、角度、重量等改进。 文章主要讲汽车维修工具生产技术的发展与改进。 A：汽车用品的良好容量 → 错误 B：提高工具耐用性的新技术 → 文中未提 durability（耐用性） C：技工的高科技发明 → 不准确，不是个人发明，是技术进步 D：汽车相关工具生产的发展 → 正确

questions.stem: What will this advance mean for mechanics?

options.B: They can meet additional customers needs

questions.analysis: What will this advance mean for mechanics? 原文依据： flexible-angle tool extend their arms longer control their movements much more weigh less than ever before 工具更轻、角度灵活、更好操作 → 工作更轻松、更容易。 A：他们可以更轻松地工作 → 正确 B：满足更多顾客需求 → 未提及 C：降低开支 → 错误，反而成本更高 D：提高利润 → 未提及
